title: Financial Market And Its Instruments Concept And Functions
definition: A financial market is a marketplace where buyers and sellers trade financial assets such as equities, bonds, currencies, and derivatives, facilitating capital formation, price discovery, and liquidity. It is broadly divided into Money Market (short-term funds up to one year) and Capital Market (long-term funds exceeding one year).
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for both Prelims (direct questions on money market instruments, SEBI/RBI regulations, G-Secs, T-Bills) and Mains GS Paper III (mobilization of resources, growth, development, and inclusive finance).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Financial Market And Its Instruments Concept And Functions.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of macroeconomics and banking
